storyCards.headline: Can't You See: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
The Marshall Tucker Band's "Can't You See" reached #75 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #75 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 6 weeks on the chart.

Can't You See was released in 1977.

"Can't You See" by The Marshall Tucker Band.
